chapter: Properties of matter: elasticity, viscosity, surface tension

variants.title: Jaeger's method: surface tension of water at 20 °C
variants.unknown: the surface tension of water at 20 °C
variants.note: Clean water against air at 20 °C: surface tension 72.75 mN/m, density 998.2 kg/m3.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, Surface tension of water against air 0-100 °C, and Density of water

variants.title: Jaeger's method: surface tension of water at 40 °C
variants.unknown: the surface tension of water at 40 °C

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, Surface tension of water against air 0-100 °C, and Density of water

variants.title: Jaeger's method: surface tension of water at 60 °C

variants.note: At 60 °C water gives 66.18 mN/m. The manometer liquid stays at room temperature, so its density is unchanged.
